project(rapps)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# rapps.com is all Rust (rapps_com-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rapps_com-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/rapps_com-rust/src/rapps_com/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(rapps.com rapps_com-cargo rapps.com
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE rapps_com-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
